title: Reward Shaping for Building Trustworthy Robots in Sequential Human-Robot Interaction
reasoning: The paper focuses on a mathematical framework for reward shaping in human-robot interaction to balance task performance and human trust. While it discusses building 'trustworthy' systems and avoiding 'deceptive' behavior, it treats these as optimization objectives in a Markov game rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, formal moral systems, or ethical frameworks.
